rule: First sound marker/ID divergence records audio incomplete, never a state/frame replay error. Thereafter ignore native sound entries and skip recorded marker245/ID pairs while every other marker/value/input remains strict. Preserve DOS ordinals; skipped-interval inputs map to the preceding completed non-sound service and IRQ completions drain at the next actual non-sound service.
tested_domain: Entry/service placement only. An IRQ inside an unmasked foreground function is outside the tested audio domain; the existing reaper instruction proof is retained and not pursued.
